title: Understanding Your Fantasy World
use_cases: Use when drafting a fantasy setting to decide which realistic elements to include.
Implement when outlining the physical laws that govern a fictional universe.
Configure when setting constraints for character abilities based on world mechanics.
Use when balancing mythic elements with plausible environment details.
Implement when writing descriptive passages that require believable setting descriptions.
content:
How do these elements fit together? How did your world come to be? And how do you make it feel ‘realistic’? I’ve put those quotes around “realistic” because we’re diving into fantasy worlds, where sometimes realism isn’t necessary. This isn’t a complete guide, just a basic look at the physical world.
